name: @local/dsh-task-notify
description: Notifications for a Harness session: an in-app toast plus a desktop notification when a turn finishes or when a session is blocked on the user (approval, question, plan review).

meta.title: 任务通知
meta.description: 任务完成或会话等待你处理（授权 / 提问 / 计划确认）时弹出应用内提示，并发送系统通知。
